title: Task
description: A TaskFlow task item representing a discrete action or request managed by a user.

id.description: MongoDB ObjectId hex string (mapped from _id). Assigned by the server.

userId.description: Owning user ID. Always sourced from the verified JWT — never from the client request body.

orgId.description: Organisation ID for multi-tenant isolation. Sourced from the verified JWT.

summaryId.description: Optional reference to the Summary document this task was derived from.

title.description: Short, human-readable title for the task.

details.description: Extended description or context for the task.

requesterName.description: Display name of the person who initiated the underlying request, if known.

requesterContact.description: Email address or other contact info for the requester.

resourceType.description: The channel or system the original request came from.

resourceLabel.description: Human-readable label for the linked resource (e.g. Jira ticket key, email subject).

resourceUrl.description: Deep-link URL to the originating resource.

targetCompletionDate.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the desired completion deadline.

actualCompletionDate.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when the task was actually completed.

reviewedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when the task was last reviewed.

doneAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when the task status was set to done.

notes.description: Free-form notes appended by the user.

followUpDraftId.description: Reference to the FollowUpDraft document created when this task was marked done.

createdAt.description: ISO-8601 creation timestamp. Set by the server.

updatedAt.description: ISO-8601 last-update timestamp. Maintained by the server on every write.
